xiaohongshu-notes-search 1.1.4

- Enhanced SKILL.md with detailed usage instructions, scenario-based routing, and input parameter guidance.
- Expanded descriptions for all four main features: keyword search, post tracking, note detail, and comment analysis.
- Added clear criteria for when to use (and not use) the skill, including prompting templates for ambiguous cases.
- Provided practical workflow examples for different analysis needs (trend research, competitor monitoring, KOL filtering).
- Clarified input rules for each mode, best-practices table, and common error patterns (“反模式”) to avoid.
- Added real-world command examples and guidance for precise, efficient Xiaohongshu data extraction.
